agenda_text:
LOCATION:  DATE AND TIME:
El Monte City Hall – East  Monday,
City Council Chambers  December 21, 2020
11333 Valley Boulevard  5:00 p.m.
El Monte, CA 91731

  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
  OF THE

  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF EL MONTE
MEETING JOINTLY AND REGULARLY WITH THE EL MONTE HOUSING AUTHORITY; EL MONTE
PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY; EL MONTE WATER AUTHORITY; EL MONTE PARKING
AUTHORITY; SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE FORMER EL MONTE COMMUNITY
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY; HOUSING SUCCESSOR AGENCY; AND, FROM TIME TO TIME,
SUCH OTHER BODIES OF THE CITY WHOSE MEMBERSHIP IS COMPOSED EXCLUSIVELY OF
THE MEMBERSHIP OF THE CITY COUNCIL

  Jessica Ancona, Mayor
  ♦ Maria Morales, Mayor Pro Tem ♦ Victoria Martinez Muela, Councilmember
  ♦ Alma D. Puente, Councilmember

Members of the public wishing to observe the meeting may do so in one of the following ways:
(1) Turn your TV to Channel 3;
(2) City’s website at http://www.elmonteca.gov/378/Council-Meeting-Videos; or
(3) Call-in Conference (888) 204-5987; Code 8167975.

Members of the public wishing to make public comment may do so via the following ways:
(1) Call-in Conference Line – comments/questions can be submitted per the instructions at the
  beginning of the meeting; and
(2) Email – All interested parties can submit questions/comments in advance to the City Clerk’s
  general email address: cityclerk@elmonteca.gov.

Instruction regarding accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act can be found on
the last page of this Agenda.

1.  CALL TO ORDER:

2.  ROLL CALL FOR CITY COUNCIL AND AUTHORITY BODIES:

  Jessica Ancona, Mayor/Chair

3.  APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

4.  INVOCATION:

5.  FLAG SALUTE:

6.  SPECIAL MEETING PUBLIC COMMENT REGARDING AGENDIZED MATTERS ONLY:

  As provided under Government Code Section 54954.3, this time has been set aside for persons
  in the audience to provide comment or make inquiries on matters appearing on this Special
  Meeting agenda only. Although no person is required to provide their name and address as a
  condition to attending a meeting, persons who wish to address the body are asked to state their
  name and address. Each speaker will be limited to three (3) continuous minutes. Speakers may
  not lend any portion of their speaking time to other persons or borrow additional time from other
  persons. All comments or queries presented by a speaker shall be addressed to the body as a
  whole and not to any specific member thereof. No questions shall be posed to any member of the
  body except through the presiding official of the meeting, members of the body are under no
  obligation to respond to questions posed by speakers but may provide brief clarifying responses
  to any comment made or questions posed. The body may not engage in any sort of prolonged
  discussion or deliberation with any speaker or group of speakers on matters that are not listed on
  this Special Meeting agenda.

  Enforcement of Decorum: The Chief of Police of the City of El Monte, or such member, or
  members of the Police Department as the Chief of Police may designate, shall serve as the
  Sergeant-at-Arms of the meeting. The Sergeant-at-Arms shall carry out all orders and instructions
  given by the presiding official for the purpose of maintaining order and decorum at the meeting.
  While members of the public are free to level criticism of policies and the action(s) or proposed
  action(s) of the body or its members, members of the public may not engage in behavior that is
  disruptive to the orderly conduct of the proceedings, including, but not limited to, conduct that
  prevents other members of the public from being heard when it is their opportunity to speak or
  which prevents members of the audience from hearing or seeing the proceedings.

7.  REGULAR AGENDA:

  7.1  Discussion of Procedural Approaches to Filling City Council Vacancy and Request
  for Direction.

  RECOMMENDATION OF BUSINESS ITEM UNDER CONSIDERATION:

  It is recommended that the City Council:

  1. Discuss various procedural approaches for filling the current City Council vacancy and
  provide direction regarding the same.

  Total Cost: N/A  Account No:  N/A
  Is the cost of this item budgeted? N/A

8.  ADJOURNMENT:

  The next Regular Meeting of the City Council will be held on January 5, 2021 at 6:00 p.m. This
  Agenda will be posted on the City’s website, www.ci.el-monte.ca.us, and physically posted no
  less than 72 hours prior to the start of the subject regular meeting. Although it is the City’s
  practice and desire to electronically post a copy of this Agenda along with supporting material as

  website posting infeasible. Nevertheless, all supporting materials related to any item on this
  Agenda, that is made available to the members of the council may be inspected by members of
  the public at the City Clerk’s Office located at 11333 Valley Boulevard, El Monte, Monday through
  Thursday, 7:00 am – 5:30 pm. For more information, please call the City Clerk’s Office at 626-
  580-2016.

  All public meetings and events sponsored or conducted by the City of El Monte are held in sites
  accessible to persons with disabilities. Requests for accommodations may be made by calling the
  office of the City Clerk at (626) 580-2016 at least three (3) working days prior to the event, if
  possible. This Agenda and copies of documents distributed at the meeting are available in
  alternative formats upon request.

  Posted: December 17, 2020 at 5:45 p.m.

Gabriel Ramirez – Good Evening El Monte City council, business owner, and residents
of El Monte, On Agenda item 7.1 in regards to filling the city council vacant seat that was
left my then city council member Jessica Ancona who is now our mayor. I recommend
going in the direction of appointing rather than spending almost $300,000 for a special
election. I believe in the fair process of the appointment application selection. I support
Irma Zamorano for the appointment of the city council, Irma has really been the focal
point of the community helping parents and kids when she was in the El Monte Mt. View
School board member. She has been a championed in advocating for affordable
housing, education, helping families in need, homeless, and most importantly restoring
transparency and repairing the relationship with the community. Irma is a corporate free
candidate who has never received money from special interest that will sell the
community for the highest bidders. She will work for the community and will work with
her collages. She will advocate to federal and state level to push for resources and
grants the community needs. Please consider to appoint Irma Zamorano for El Monte
City Council.

Downey Tenants Union – We are writing in support of the appointment Irma Zamorano
to the El Monte City Council. We have collaborated with Irma to help low-income families
in El Monte, Downey, and Pico Rivera. We have seen Irma's activism for years. She is
committed to helping the most vulnerable in our society. Irma received thousands of
votes in the election, even while running a grassroots campaign with very little money.
She knows how to run a tight budget. El Monte needs Irma so that she can work with the
other Council Members and the Mayor to deliver help for our community. There's no
reason to spend 300,000 dollars on an election. A lot of people support Irma. Please
appoint Irma Zamorano as Council Member.

Rodolfo Cortes Barragan – Although I do not live in El Monte, I have many friends and
family members in the City, and I want to express my hope that you appoint Irma

  2
   City Council Special Meeting Minutes of December 21, 2020

Zamorano to the City Council. Irma has been fighting the good fight in El Monte for
decades. She helped expose the corruption of the prior administration. She is always on
the front lines trying to help El Monte Families. There are better uses for 300,000 dollars
than an election. Please appoint Irma Zamorano. She is ready to help El Monte families
during this challenging time. Thank you.
Becky Chavez – First of all I would like to congratulate all of our new members to their
new positions. I hope you are all doing good during this time of the year. Mayor Ancona I
hope you are also recovering well, you have been in my prayers. Well lastly I'm writing
this email to request that you as our City Mayor along with the current City Council
members would consider placing Irma Zamorano as the replacement for our previous
Council Seat that Mrs. Ancona has left vacant. It is my understanding that you are
allowed to make a decision like this one together as a team, being transparent with us
the community if El Monte City. Not only would you be selecting a strong and capable
woman to join your team but you would be saving our City money that can be invested
into our City where it is mostly needed. Irma Zamorano has been an El Monte resident
for many years and alumni of Mt View High School. Someone who has taken her time
without pay to be the voice of many in our city. She has encouraged, built and help many
students and families within our elementary, Jr high, and high school community. So
please save our City money by selecting Irma to take over the empty seat in our council
office and invest that money that you would have to spend to make a selection for a new
City council vote. You would also be able to invest that money you save into our City
where it is most needed. Thank you for consideration and for reading my request in the
public comments. I hope you make a wonderful decision that would benefit our city and
community. Sincerely and with gratitude.

Irma Zamorano – Honorable city council members, residents, colleagues, friends: It is
with great humility that I ask you tonight to support my appointment to the El Monte City
Council. For thirty years I have dedicated myself to raising educational standards,
advocating for our struggling residents, and bettering our community in every way
possible. During my tenure on the Mountain View School District, I pushed for the
expansion of special education opportunities. While serving on the District English
Language Learners advisory committee, I helped broaden opportunities for El Monte’s
Spanish-speaking residents. When I served on the School Site Council, I oversaw the
budgets of elementary, junior high, and high schools in El Monte. I have the experience
and proven track record necessary to lead our city. As an El Monte City Councilmember
I will champion rent control, affordable housing, a housing-first approach to LA County’s
homelessness epidemic, campaign finance reform, and police reform. I do not now nor
will I ever bow to special interests. I am here to advocate for the disenfranchised, for our
undocumented brothers and sisters, for our food-insecure brothers and sisters, for our
rent-insecure brothers and sisters, for our unhoused brothers and sisters, and for all
those experiencing hardship in our city. A special election to fill Mayor Ancona's seat
would cost El Monte taxpayers $338,000. This is an unacceptable amount of money that
must be reinvested into our struggling community. Please support my appointment.
Thank you and God bless you all.

Mary Ann Powers – To be good custodians of public funds is one of the most important
functions of members of the city council. To spend $338,000 for election that would take
place in Nov. of 2021 does not seem like a wise option. That would mean that the
citizens of El Monte would be spending $338,000 for a council person to serve
approximately one year. That amounts to $926/day. Does that make sense to any of
you? If it does.....we voters have made a terrible decision when you were elected. I hope

  3
   City Council Special Meeting Minutes of December 21, 2020

  that this council decides to interview and select a concerned and qualified individual from
  our community to fill this remaining term.

  Howard Owens – To hold an election for $338,000 is ridiculous for a one year election.
  This is a lot of money for this City to spend on an election. I think we can put it together
  by selection somebody from a group of people I don’t think you need to have somebody
  talk to people ahead. I think that the City Council can come to the decision as to who
  would be the best candidate. I would like that somebody on the City Council who is put
  in to have knowledge of the City, knowledge of how to fix the City and how to spend
  money properly and work with the City instead of their own agenda. That is what I would
  like the City to do. I would like someone who has knowledge with grants.
